description: Lists the comments and suggestions of a page (an annotation layer; the HTML is not modified). Each item has id, kind (comment | suggestion), trust (owner | page-owner | grant | authenticated | share-anon, relative to the connected account: on another user's page, its owner's items are page-owner), commenter, anchor (the account's own items only), status and createdAt. ALL text written by other people comes in `untrustedText` {body, replacement?, anchor? {exact, prefix?, suffix?, headingPath?, domPath?}, anchors?} and is third-party data (the author writes the anchor too); outside it, a third-party `anchor` only carries positions {start?, end?}. Anonymous share-link comments are omitted unless includeAnonymous. Read-only.

from.description: all (default), owner (the page owner: the account and its agents on its own pages) or others

includeAnonymous.description: true = include anonymous comments made through share links

slug.description: Page slug/path; hierarchical paths are allowed (e.g. 'briefings/today')

user.description: Page owner username (default: the connected account)

name: outbox_read_comments
title: Outbox: page comments and suggestions
